# House Beautiful

> House Beautiful is the premier destination for home design inspiration, interior decorating ideas, and lifestyle content covering everything from kitchen and bathroom renovations to entertaining and gardening.

House Beautiful provides comprehensive home design guidance through curated articles, designer home tours, product shopping guides, and lifestyle inspiration. The site features contributions from renowned designers like Leanne Ford and covers emerging design trends such as micro-zoning, along with timeless decorating principles for every room and space.

## Design Inspiration & Ideas

- [Best Interior Design Ideas - Beautiful Home Design Inspiration](https://www.housebeautiful.com/design-inspiration): Interior design ideas and house tours featuring designer homes and decor
- [100+ Best Room Decorating Ideas - Home Design Pictures](https://www.housebeautiful.com/room-decorating): Room decorating ideas for every space including bedrooms, bathrooms, and patios
- [A Colorful "Conversation Piece" Kitchen Sets the Tone for This Modern Toronto Home](https://www.housebeautiful.com/design-inspiration/house-tours/a70761591/home-tour-lisa-lev-design-studio-sonny-toronto-canada): Home tour featuring Lisa Lev Design Studio's colorful modern Toronto kitchen
- [Designers Are Ditching Open-Concept Layouts for "Micro-Zones" in 2026](https://www.housebeautiful.com/design-inspiration/a70685353/micro-zoning-open-concept-living): Design trend article on micro-zoning as alternative to open-concept layouts

- [Home Renovation Ideas - How To Renovate a House](https://www.housebeautiful.com/home-remodeling): Home renovation and remodeling guides for kitchens, bathrooms, and planning
